CONVERSATION.NAME: Convince Matthew
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: Convince Matthew that you have Sara's best interests at heart.

CARD.NAME: Are you threatened?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Are you threatened by our mighty GRRRL power? (All your dialog that increases trust is stronger)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of trust,

CARD.NAME: Even my Barbies hooked up
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dude – even my Barbies hooked up. Ken was just there to refill their lattes.

CARD.NAME: I appreciate the protective
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I appreciate the protective Papa Lion thing and all, but kitty's gotta leave the cave.

CARD.NAME: I can't help but wonder
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I can't help but wonder if you DO have more than just friendly feelings for her?

CARD.NAME: I really like that painting.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I really like that painting. Is it yours? Is it hard to get a ferret to hold a pose for that long?

CARD.NAME: I watch Rosie's video blog
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I watch Rosie's video blog every day. Would a totally straight girl do that?

CARD.NAME: If you are really her friend
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you are really her friend, you'll want what's best for Sara. I'm what's best.

CARD.NAME: Just because you're a guy
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Just because you're a guy doesn't mean you're unnecessary. You can reach high shelves for us or something

CARD.NAME: NOT your best shade
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Um, I don't know what the guy equivalent of "fag hag" is, but you're wearing that, and it's NOT your best shade.

CARD.NAME: Sara is a big girl
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara is a big girl and can make her own decisions.

CARD.NAME: Sara is so lucky
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara is so lucky to have a friend like you looking out for her.

CARD.NAME: Total respect
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I totally respect your friendship, and I'd never get in the way.

CARD.NAME: Watch us kiss
CARD.DESCRIPTION: We'll even let you watch us kiss if that's what you're desperately into. And wow, I hope you're not.

CARD.NAME: Has-bian
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You could just turn out to be a has-bian like Claire and decide you're just playing around.

CARD.NAME: Looking out for a friend
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm looking out for my friend, and if you can't respect that, you might as well just have a Y-chromosome. (All of Matthew's -trust cards are stronger)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of trust,

CARD.NAME: Looking out for my friend
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm looking out for my friend, and if you can't respect that, you might as well just have a Y-chromosome.

CARD.NAME: No funny blogs
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'd better not find out that you're just doing this for kicks and funny blog entries.

CARD.NAME: No sugar mama
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Even successful poets don't make much money. You'd better not be in it for a sugar mama.

CARD.NAME: Not much of interest
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You don't have much of interest to say, do you? I might as well be meditating.

CARD.NAME: Not to yourself
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You may think you'll have Sara all to yourself, but I will ALWAYS be a big part of the picture.

CARD.NAME: Sara never met...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara never met a stray cat or frozen vegan entree she didn't just HAVE to pick up. Can you deal?

CARD.NAME: Sara will always pick
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara will always pick my company over anyone else.

CARD.NAME: Serious Artist
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you were a Serious Artist like Sara and me, you'd understand that we need time and space to do our work.

CARD.NAME: Weight test
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Seriously – how much can you bench?

CARD.NAME: You're here.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're here. You're queer. Impress me.
